def classify(r,g,b):
    # bright/white glass highlights
    mx, mn = max(r,g,b), min(r,g,b)
    if r>150 and g>100 and b<110 and r>b+60:  # orange/pink juice
        return 'J'
    if r>200 and g>200 and b>200:
        return 'W'  # white highlight
    if abs(r-g)<20 and abs(g-b)<25 and r>140:
        return '.'  # gray bg
    if r>g and g>b and (r-b)>30 and r<170:

    if mx-mn < 30:

for gy in range(gh):
    line=''

        y0,y1 = gy*h//gh,(gy+1)*h//gh
        x0,x1 = gx*w//gw,(gx+1)*w//gw

        line += classify(r,g,b)
    print(line)
